title: LEGO-Xtal GPU: Local Environment Geometry-Oriented Crystal Generator
summary: A GPU-accelerated generative pipeline that learns crystal-structure representations from known material examples and uses GAN/VAE/CVAE models to produce and optimize novel crystal candidates for materials design. Its data_transformer.py module imports rdt's ClusterBasedNormalizer and OneHotEncoder directly from the standalone rdt package to preprocess discrete and continuous structural features before model training.
needs: Only the import line is visible; instantiation/call of ClusterBasedNormalizer or OneHotEncoder elsewhere in data_transformer.py is inferred, not directly shown.
